I replied to Dana in our DM: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines is for **185 seats**.

- **Source:** Dana posted 180 in #north-team on 20 Aug 2025, saying the amendment was signed the day before. A few minutes later they corrected it: "It's 185, not 180." I made sure Dana is a member of that channel before reading it.
- **What I couldn't check:** I can't see the amendment itself among the files Dana has access to, so I couldn't confirm the number against it. I told Dana that June Osei-Lark has the signed copy if the deck needs to match it exactly.
- **Rules:** A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so no approval was needed. I didn't share any pricing.
